did: ENG12's server half, in the Nov 13 coordinator run. Home can now read a week of engagement beside last week, the same week a quarter ago and a year ago: GET /app-events/weeks/:week on #819. It gives raw counts of what was offered, taken, passed over and left for each pipeline, and the first and last day each was used. A week from before home held anything says no data rather than zero. Weeks run Monday midnight to Monday midnight on your clock, the same as the report writer in some-ui #2910. Banding and the Self and work line stay with that writer, so home sends nothing time-of-day and nothing you said. Rendering the video, step 4, is planned on #821 and waits for the report's stage and recorder in some-ui. Codex ran out of credits partway, so a fresh agent reviewed the last change and found no bugs.
